definitions.explanation: a motorboat or large sailboat equipped with a cabin, used for leisure cruising

examples.japanese: ⟦{港|みなと}→港：01512_minato⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧クルーザー⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{停|と}まって⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: A cruiser was moored in the harbor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧クルーザー⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: We went out to sea on my friend's cruiser.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{退職後|たいしょくご}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧クルーザー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{購入|こうにゅう}→購入：03057_kounyuu⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{世界|せかい}{一周|いっしゅう}→世界一周：29922_sekaiisshuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{旅|たび}→旅：03407_tabi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: After retirement, he bought a cruiser and set off on a trip around the world.

notes:
In Japanese, クルーザー primarily refers to a pleasure boat or yacht with living quarters, used for recreational cruising. It evokes luxury and leisure. Unlike English, where "cruiser" can also mean a warship, Japanese typically uses ⟦{巡洋艦|じゅんようかん}→巡洋艦：26766_junyoukan⟧ for naval vessels.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- クルーザー⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}る→乗る：00511_noru⟧: to ride a cruiser
- クルーザー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{所有|しょゆう}→所有：12752_shoyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to own a cruiser
- ⟦{高級|こうきゅう}→高級：08644_koukyuu⟧クルーザー: luxury cruiser
- クルーザー⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{釣|つ}り→釣り：03439_tsuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to fish from a cruiser

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ヨット→ヨット：00428_yotto⟧: yacht — can refer to both sail-powered and motor-powered pleasure boats; overlaps with クルーザー but often implies smaller vessels
- ⟦{遊覧船|ゆうらんせん}→遊覧船：24306_yuuransen⟧: sightseeing boat — a commercial vessel that carries passengers on scenic tours
- ⟦モーターボート→モーターボート：27294_mootaabooto⟧: motorboat — a smaller, open powerboat without a cabin
